platform: GitHub Pages PWA + Google Play TWA; Chrome MV3 source retained
product_thesis: الدين ثابت والمشكلة تختلف؛ رفيق بوابة يومية تربط المستخدم بالقرآن والذكر والعلم وتساعده في مشكلاته الواقعية بمصدر ظاهر وخطوة عملية.
non_negotiables: Every religious claim displayed in the app must have a visible source; unsourced religious claims are removed or rewritten.
Fiqh al-Nafs content is educational synthesis inspired by Makany methodology unless a specific quote is verified.
Mental-health content never replaces qualified medical/psychological care.
Nightly review stays lightweight: 5 essentials, quick choices, optional mood, one optional tomorrow note.
Age and male/female personalization is local-only and used only where meaningful.
Do not invent sacred counts, durations, promises, or spiritual ranks.
Keep + / Saved for later across content.
Do not restore the previously rejected home-page tagline; preserve the current calmer copy.

The Ishkaliat track is opt-in, does not classify religiosity, and every displayed idea links to the original Dr. Ahmed Abdelmonem video + timestamp; supplied summaries are not treated as verbatim transcripts.
Existing user data is production legacy data: no persistent key/shape/content-ID change without a backward-compatible migration and rollback path.
AI_HANDOFF.md is immutable project continuity: never delete/rename/truncate/exclude it; append every session chat/change ledger.
Google Play package identity for current listing is com.tadaruqnoor.rafiq; do not generate future Play bundles under a different package ID.
Never commit Android signing keystore/passwords or API/Play credentials.

storage_keys.qalb_paths: qalb-paths-v1 (selected heart/obstacle/Fiqh-al-Nafs paths, local progress, check-ins)

key_sources.sahaba_dua_verification: Dorar individual hadith/athar links stored per item in app/adiya.json

roadmap: deep-link saved items and personal paths to exact content
refine personal-path prioritization without diagnosing users
verify/refine Ishkaliat summaries against actual transcripts/official text when available
expand real-life obstacles with rigorous sources
licensed human audio for adhkar when a verified source/licence exists
current_release_changes: R16 preserves the full AI_HANDOFF.md and adds an immutable owner rule: never delete/rename/truncate/exclude it; append every session chat/change ledger.
Mushaf fullscreen now requests native Fullscreen API on documentElement, tracks visualViewport height, and auto-hides controls while preserving fixed 604-page KFQC SVG geometry.
Prayer setup now explains Android/browser geolocation permission, device timezone behavior, local-only coordinate storage, manual fallback, and permission/error states.
Home gateway UI was restructured into welcome + prayer status + primary Quran/adhkar actions + smaller learning/fiqh/tazkiyah/Irtaqi gateways.
Saved header numeric bubble was replaced with a subtle 7px status dot; accessible title retains the exact saved count.
PWA service worker update flow was tightened (R16 cache, updateViaCache none, SKIP_WAITING/controllerchange reload) to reduce stale GitHub Pages updates.
No persistent storage key/shape/stable saved-content ID changed; Data Safety schema v1 remains unchanged.

data_architecture.chrome_app_state: localStorage via app store wrapper; extension notebook/prefs use chrome.storage.local
data_architecture.decision_required_before_cloud: owner must explicitly approve analytics vs account sync, data categories, privacy and retention
data_architecture.safety_layer: app/data-safety.js; local snapshot + migration + validation + rollback + portable backup

google_play.production_gate: At least 12 opted-in closed testers for at least 14 consecutive days, then apply for Production access (as shown in owner Play Console).
google_play.assetlinks_requirement: Use com.tadaruqnoor.rafiq + Google Play App Signing SHA-256 in /.well-known/assetlinks.json.
google_play.secret_rule: Never commit signing.keystore, signing passwords/info, API tokens, or Play credentials.

immutable_handoff_policy.session_rule: Append chronological chat/change/test/error/decision ledger before returning artifacts; preserve prior history.
